comments.text: Calculate direction using the delta between the velocity and the actor rotation. When the character is not strafing, clamp the value between - and + 45 degrees so that backwards animations do not play when turning around, but running into wall looks better.
Only update values if the character is valid (character exists in the world and the reference is set).
Set Is Falling from the movement components falling state.
Set references to owning character when this blueprint initializes.
Set Should Move to true only if ground speed is above a small threshold (to prevent incredibly small velocities from triggering animations) and if there is currently acceleration (input) applied.
Set velocity and ground speed from the movement components velocity. Ground speed is calculated from only the X and Y axis of the velocity, so moving up or down does not affect it.
